p_fb5714.name: RED FLAG — SCARLET REBELLION HOODIE
p_fb5714.desc:
Make them stare. Let the red flag speak. 🚩

Introducing the **Red Flag — Scarlet Rebellion Hoodie** by NALAYAK. A bold, oversized streetwear essential in deep crimson, featuring the unapologetic statement “I am a red flag but the material is quality” on the front and striking Indian-inspired artwork on the back.

Designed for those who refuse to blend in, this piece combines desi attitude with rebellious street culture. The rich red colour, statement graphics, and premium-inspired details make it a standout addition to your rotation.

**Details**
- Bold crimson-red colourway
- Oversized streetwear aesthetic
- Statement typography on the front
- Eye-catching illustrated back graphic
- Ribbed cuffs and hem with a relaxed silhouette

**Wear your chaos. Own your red flag. Stay NALAYAK.**

*Fabric composition, GSM, and fit specifications should be confirmed before publishing as product facts.*
p_fb5714.care: Cold machine wash inside out. Dry in shade.

p_92dc77.name: RED FLAG — DESI REBELLION HOODIE
p_92dc77.desc:
Not every red flag is a warning. Some are a whole statement. 🚩

Meet the Red Flag — Desi Rebellion Hoodie by NALAYAK, where unapologetic attitude meets Indian street culture. Drenched in deep crimson red, this statement piece features the iconic words “I am a red flag but the material is quality” across the front, paired with bold vintage-inspired Indian artwork on the back.

Made for the ones who break rules, challenge expectations, and wear their personality without an apology. The relaxed streetwear silhouette, striking graphic placement, and rich red colour make this hoodie impossible to ignore.

THE DETAILS

Deep crimson red colourway

Bold statement typography on the front

Vintage-inspired desi artwork on the back

Hooded design with adjustable drawstrings

Front kangaroo pocket

Ribbed cuffs and hem

Statement streetwear aesthetic

Your vibe. Your rules. Your red flag.

NALAYAK — Not made for everyone.
p_92dc77.care: Cold machine wash inside out. Dry in shade.

rev-01.author: Rohan D.
rev-01.quote: The 240 GSM weight is no joke. Most Indian streetwear brands claim boxy and send you a limp regular tee. This holds its silhouette even after three hard washes in Kolkata humidity.

rev-02.author: Ananya M.
rev-02.quote: Wore the No Approval tee to a family Diwali function. My uncle stared at the back graphic for two straight minutes without speaking. 10/10, brand promise fulfilled.

rev-03.author: Kabir S.
rev-03.highlight: TRUE DROP SHOULDER WITHOUT EXCESS BAGGAGE
rev-03.quote: True drop shoulder that actually drapes down the tricep rather than just looking two sizes too big. Collar ribbing is tight 1.25" and doesn’t bacon after line drying.

rev-04.author: Tanya K.
rev-04.highlight: SCREENPRINT IN THE FIBERS, NOT PLASTIC
rev-04.quote: The screenprint feels embedded into the cotton fibers instead of a thick rubbery sticker slapped on top. Breathable even when riding in 32° heat.

rev-05.author: Varun P.
rev-05.highlight: DOUBLE-LAYER HOOD THAT ACTUALLY STANDS UP
rev-05.quote: Heaviest hoodie in my rotation. The double-layered hood actually stays upright and doesn’t collapse flat against your collarbones. Ribbed cuffs don’t stretch out.

rev-06.author: Meera V.
rev-06.highlight: SHARP BOXY CROP WITHOUT BEING FLIMSY
rev-06.quote: Most women’s streetwear crops are either paper-thin or cut like an awkward square box. This has proper structured shoulders and sits right at the high waistband.
